name: minreport-core
description: MINREPORT Backend Core (Cloud Run + Firebase Gen 2)

scripts.dev:server: NODE_ENV=test MOCK_EMAILS=true FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9190 FIRESTORE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD=SuperAdmin123! nodemon --watch src src/index.ts
scripts.dev:server:test: NODE_ENV=test MOCK_EMAILS=true FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8085 FIREBASE_AUTH_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:9190 FIRESTORE_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD=SuperAdmin123! nodemon --watch src src/index.ts
scripts.build:functions: npm install --prefix services/functions && npm run build --prefix services/functions
scripts.dev:all: npm run sync:plugins && npm run build:functions && npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run serve:emulators" "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev --prefix web" "npm run dev --prefix admin" "npm run watch:sdk"
scripts.watch:sdk: nodemon --watch src/sdk -e ts --exec "bash web/scripts/copy-sdk.sh && bash admin/scripts/copy-sdk.sh"
scripts.backup: git add . && (git commit -m "Auto-save" || true) && git push
